title: Reading raw Project Blue Book case files

tellings.quote: topic and I've read the the raw case files, the raw blue book case, like uh no analysis, just right, just the straight uh reports

plain: The records of Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, include raw case files: the reports as they were first written, before anyone analysed them. Marik von Rennenkampff, a writer on the subject, says on the show that he has read these "raw blue book case" files, "just the straight uh reports", with "no analysis", and he offers this as his grounding for judging the topic first-hand.
